name: in_numeric_list
query: SELECT year, count(*) AS n WHERE year NOT IN (2016, 2018) AND number IN (4, 8.95) AND account ~ '^Expenses:Financial' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
notes: NOT IN over a list of ints; IN mixes an int literal (4) and a decimal (8.95), and the decimal column number = 4.00 must match the int 4.
